ov.title: Couriers
ov.sub: Every courier at a glance: parcels on the way, cash they hold, how they are doing.
ov.empty: No courier is set up yet. Add one under Setup.
ov.needsStuck: {n} parcels have not moved: ask the courier.
ov.needsLines: {n} statement lines do not match our records.
ov.needsClaims: {n} claims are waiting for the courier.
ov.compareSub: Success and cost per parcel over the last 30 days.
ov.savings: Money we would save with per-area routing
ov.savingsOff: Switch on "Choose the courier by cost" in Setup to see this line.
ov.savingsNone: Not enough rate-card prices to compare yet.
ov.savingsLeft: {n} parcels have no rate-card price and are left out.

c.weeksSub: Delivered of finished parcels, last 8 weeks.

m.title: Money
m.noPerm: Seeing this courier's money needs the payments permission.
m.heldSub: Collected and not on a statement yet: {n} parcels.
m.settleSub: Average over {n} statement lines, slowest {max} days.
m.monthBody: {n} statements in {ym}: it paid {cod}, deducted {charges}, net {net}.
m.noStatements: No statement from this courier yet.
m.openSub: Statement lines that differ from our records and are not resolved.
m.openDetail: Open the Differences page to resolve a line.

reasons.UNKNOWN_PARCEL: a parcel we do not know
reasons.NOT_COLLECTED: paid for a parcel we have as not delivered

f.title: Performance
f.lateNone: No parcel is past its promise.
f.chargesNone: The courier reported no charge yet.

s.title: Setup
s.keysHelp: Type the courier's keys there. Until the Test passes, the courier runs in practice mode.
s.areasHelp: Pair the shop's areas with the courier's own place list.
s.ratesHelp: What this courier really charges us, by zone and weight.
s.backupHelp: Chosen on the With courier page, where parcels move to it.
s.routingHelp: Off or on in Delivery settings; the overview shows the money it would save.

card.d: The courier a booking offers first and the one listed first.
card.first: The first courier in the list

payouts.d: Ask a courier to pay what it holds, through the courier's own payment request. Off until you switch it on.
payouts.enabledHelp: When on, a person with the right and the owner's PIN can ask a courier to pay. Nothing is ever asked by itself.
payouts.pollMinutesHelp: How often the courier is asked where a request stands.
payouts.minAmountMinorHelp: In the smallest unit of the currency (100 = one whole unit). 0 means no minimum.

claims.d: Give a claim a deadline and flag the late ones. Off until you switch it on.
claims.deadlineEnabledHelp: A claim gets a deadline when it is raised; one past it shows as late.
claims.days: Days the courier has to pay
claims.daysHelp: Counted from the day the claim is raised.
claims.warnDays: Flag as due soon, days before
claims.postRecovered: Post money won back to the courier's account
claims.postRecoveredHelp: Keep this off until the owner has said yes.

t.readOnly: You can see this but not change it.
t.stale: Someone changed this meanwhile. The page shows the newest; try again.

tab.title: Couriers
tab.sub: Every courier's numbers, parcels and money in one place.

y.title: Payouts
y.sub: Ask the courier to pay what it holds, through the courier's own payment request.
y.off: Payouts are switched off. Turn them on in Delivery settings.
y.read: This courier only shows what it paid; we cannot ask it from here.
y.noneCourier: This courier has no payment request of its own. Its money comes on its statement.
y.holds: What it holds for us now
y.holdsBody: {cash} collected on {n} parcels, less its charges {charges}: {net} to ask for.
y.asked: Asked. The courier's answer is read back by itself.

blocked.OPEN: An earlier request is still open.
blocked.NOTHING: It holds nothing to ask for.
blocked.BELOW_MINIMUM: Less than the smallest amount to ask for.

y.diff: The courier paid {diff} {dir} what the parcels come to. Check its statement.
y.unconfirmed: The courier did not confirm this request. Check its panel before asking again.
y.closeNote: Why (what you saw in the courier's panel)
y.noPerm: You can see this but not ask. Asking needs the payments settle permission.

err.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong tries. Wait and try again.
err.PIN_NOT_SET: The owner has not set a PIN yet.
err.PAYOUT_NOT_SUPPORTED: This courier has no payment request of its own.
err.PAYOUT_OPEN: An earlier request is still open.
err.PAYOUT_NOTHING: Nothing to ask for, or less than the smallest amount.
err.other: Something went wrong. Nothing was asked twice; look at the list and try again.

k.claimable: Lost or damaged, not claimed yet
k.check: Choose the parcel, type an amount and say what happened.
k.noParcels: This courier has no parcels yet.
